// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.22

|gr2= Math - Vectors

|descr= Subtracts one 3D vector from another. (vector1 - vector2)<br>
{{Feature|GVI|arma3|2.14|Since {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} any count of numbers is valid, if one array is larger than the other, the remaining elements are inserted without change.<br>
Before {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}}, the first argument had to be vector 3D, or {{GVI|arma3|2.00|size= 0.75}} 2D (Which still returned 3D result, with z coordinate defaulted to 0)}} 


|s1= vector1 [[vectorDiff]] vector2

|p1= vector1: [[Array]] of [[Number]]s

|p2= vector2: [[Array]] of [[Number]]s

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Number]]s

|x1= <sqf>hint str (velocity car vectorDiff velocity bike);</sqf>

|seealso= [[vectorAdd]] [[vectorCrossProduct]] [[vectorDotProduct]] [[vectorCos]] [[vectorMagnitude]] [[vectorMagnitudeSqr]] [[vectorMultiply]] [[vectorDistance]] [[vectorDistanceSqr]] [[vectorDir]] [[vectorUp]] [[setVectorDir]] [[setVectorUp]] [[setVectorDirAndUp]] [[vectorNormalized]] [[vectorFromTo]]
}}

{{Note
|user= ffur2007slx2_5
|timestamp= 20140628090900
|text= {{GVI|arma3|1.22}} Algorithm:
<sqf>
Vector1 = [x1,y1,z1]; Vector2 = [x2,y2,z2];
Result = [x1 - x2, y1 - y2, z1 - z2];
</sqf>
It is recommended to use [[vectorDiff]] instead of [[BIS_fnc_vectorDiff]].
}}
